examples.arabic: يوسف: نادي الزمالك، صاحبي عنده ماتش كورة هناك.
examples.english: Youssef: Zamalek club, my friend has a football match there.
examples.transliteration: Youssef: Nady el Zamalek, sahby 3ando match kora henak.

examples.arabic: إحنا بناكل الأكل لكن بنفكر في الناس هناك.
examples.english: We eat the food but we think about the people there.
examples.transliteration: Ehna binakul el-akl lakin binfakkir fi en-nas honak.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: بعد كده، رحنا بيت جدنا عشان العيلة كلها بتتجمع هناك.
examples.english: After that, we went to our grandfather's house because the whole family gathers there.
examples.transliteration: baad keda, rohna beyt gedena ashan el ayla kolaha betetgamaa henak.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: انا شفت صاحبي القديم احمد هناك
examples.english: I saw my old friend Ahmed there.
examples.transliteration: ana shoft sahby el adim ahmed henak

examples.english: I saw my uncle who works there.

examples.arabic: انا رحت المحل وشفت الراجل اللي بيشتغل هناك
examples.english: I went to the shop and saw the man who works there.
examples.transliteration: ana roht el mahal we shoft el ragel elly biyeshtaghal henak
